rationale: Reuses the published X400a family equations from the header of the predecessor, independently searches fresh rational parameters and derives point seeds; preserves its promoted board as the regression parent.
evidence: The predecessor file header gives A=q(121q-99p)(26p-23q)(75p-44q) and B=p(21q-74p)(25p-36q)(p+77q), attributed there to wgxli. Candidate x400a-conductor-simd.cpp uses those factors to sieve fresh p/q, x400a-family.gp evaluates independently derived sections, and the new board file specializes p=35213,q=16986. No predecessor parameter or point list is submitted as the new curve.
